run_watermark_multibit: run the multibit watermarking pipeline to embed messages in images using a neural network backbone
run_decode_watermarks: run the decode only mode to extract watermarks from watermarked images in a folder
build_argument_parser: build an argparse parser with experiment message marking and optimization parameters for watermarking
generate_carriers: generate carrier direction vectors for the latent space and save them to a file
evaluate_watermarks: evaluate watermarked images against various attacks and aggregate results into CSV files
